narrative.tension_explanation: There is no confirmed active tension this week, though the entries carry a clear sense of your choices and voice being crowded out. Earlier, your mother-in-law changed Sami’s schedule without consulting you; later, when she took over after his fever, you wrote, “I should be grateful but it felt like being dismissed.” What remains less clear is how much room you felt you had to choose your own path while also carrying family customs and expectations.
narrative.reflective_question: When you look across these moments, where did you feel most able—or least able—to have your own say?
